incoming.bodyText:
Hi John,

As never tear isn’t an option on the website for the back cover we would need to do a separate quote for you.

Could you please have look at the online calculator and let me know the exact specifications you require and advise you want never tear for the back cover and we can work out a cost for you.

Please note set up costs are included in quote price and shipping and VAT is added at checkout so these won’t be added until you physically order on the website.

Many thanks,
Bon

sendArguments.subject: Re: Budget feasibility: waterproof gardening guide, £25 delivered retail, 50–500 copies

body.content:
Hi Bon,

Thank you for getting back to me and explaining that a NeverTear back cover would need a separate quote. I have revisited the online calculator and kept the specification and indicative prices for future reference.

We have decided to launch a conventional paperback first to establish demand, and defer the waterproof wire-bound edition to a possible later print run. Please close the current enquiry for now; there is no need to spend further time preparing a bespoke quote at this stage.

If we revisit the waterproof edition, I will come back with an updated page count and exact specification, including the NeverTear back cover and preferred finished size.

Thank you again for your time and help—it is much appreciated.

Best wishes,
John Lennon

outgoing.verification: Re-read thread after send; exact message ID and SENT label confirmed.

disposition: Thanked Bon, explained conventional paperback launch and deferred waterproof edition, asked to close current enquiry with no bespoke estimate needed. No orders, fees, proof approvals, sample dispatches or commitments.
